title: Māradhammo
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Māradhammo Māradhammo ti bhante vuccati || || Katamo nu kho bhante Māradhammo ti || || 4 Rūpaṃ kho Rādha Māradhammo vedanā Māradhammo saññā Māradhammo saṅkhārā Māradhammo viññāṇam Māradhammo || || 5 Evam passaṃ Rādha || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
